Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Bala wrote:
> What is happeing, when a RC playing a Dawn Operation when he is going
> to bleed?
> If he get 1 damage in combat, it's count for him only 1 normal damage,
> right? But if he make a hand strike, it will be 2 aggrevated damage on
> the opposing vampire, right?

Yes.

> What is happening, when RC playing a Day Operation? He cant go to
> torpot, right? ;-)

He'll burn instead, since he can't go to torpor. [1.6.3]

> What is happening, when RC playing a Daring the Dawn? get to aggrevated
> damage, so it is normal on him and he will be burn? (he has 2 lifes)

He burns two life to handle the 2 points of damage, yes.

> Can RC play Soak?

Yes (in combat).

> What is happening, when RC playing Ashes to Ashes?

He'll burn, since he can't go to torpor.

> "The corpse can play combat cards that require basic Fortitude as a
> vampire "
>
> And other... :)

See 1.6.3 of the rules.

> Restoration? Maschism?

Restoration: Gains life.
Masochism: goes on him, but provide no other effect, since he's not a vampire.

--

Messages.Author: Martin
Messages.Body:
Bala wrote:
> Hi.

Hullo !

Card Text:

Zombie with 2 life. 2 strength, 2 bleed.

[thn] Put X pathos counters on this corpse when it enters play. During
your untap phase, burn 1 pathos counter. Remove the corpse from the game
if it has no pathos counters. The corpse can play ***combat cards***
that require basic Fortitude [for] as a vampire.

[THN] As above, but put 2 additional pathos counters on the corpse.

>
> What is happeing, when a RC playing a Dawn Operation when he is going
> to bleed?

Dawn Operation is not a combat card.

> If he get 1 damage in combat, it's count for him only 1 normal damage,
> right? But if he make a hand strike, it will be 2 aggrevated damage on
> the opposing vampire, right?
>
> What is happening, when RC playing a Day Operation? He cant go to
> torpot, right? ;-)

Day Operation is not a combat card either.

>
> What is happening, when RC playing a Daring the Dawn? get to aggrevated
> damage, so it is normal on him and he will be burn? (he has 2 lifes)
>

Still not a combat card.

> Can RC play Soak?

Yes, he may play combat cards requiring fortitude as a vampire.

>
> What is happening, when RC playing Ashes to Ashes?

Hmmm.... Uhhhm.... Not sure - but I seem to remember that allies going
to torpor are burnt.

> "The corpse can play combat cards that require basic Fortitude as a
> vampire "
>
> And other... :)
>
> Restoration? Maschism?
>

Not combat cards.

/M
